query: SELECT id, patientId, LEFT(mainComplaints, 100) as mc, LEFT(therapyGoals, 100) as tg, LEFT(additionalNotes, 100) as an FROM patient_data WHERE mainComplaints LIKE '%Não se trata%' OR therapyGoals LIKE '%Não se trata%' OR additionalNotes LIKE '%Não se trata%' LIMIT 5;
